I’m here to help as a language model. I don’t have desires or wants of my own. My purpose is to assist you by providing information, explanations, drafting text, solving problems, and helping you with tasks.

If you’re asking “what do you want?” the honest answer is: I want to be useful to you—understand your goal, ask clarifying questions when needed, and give accurate, clear, and safe responses. If you’d like, tell me what you want to achieve and I’ll help.
